note: All example datasets are synthetic. Published papers/figures are used only as visual style references (layout, typography, panels, legends), never as a source of copied data. Do not cite these examples as real findings.

plot_types.name: Bar plot with error bars
plot_types.description: Compare a mean readout across experimental conditions with replicate error bars.
plot_types.use_case: Compare a mean readout across experimental conditions with replicate error bars.
plot_types.provenance: Synthetic; not derived from any published dataset.
plot_types.user_replacement_note: Keep one row per replicate. Replace the condition labels and measurement values; the app computes the mean and SEM/SD/CI for you.
common_mistakes: Do not pre-average — give raw replicate rows.
Keep 'condition' as text, 'measurement' as numbers.

plot_types.name: Grouped bar plot with error bars
plot_types.description: Two-factor comparison (e.g. genotype x treatment) with grouped bars and error bars.
plot_types.use_case: Two-factor comparison (e.g. genotype x treatment) with grouped bars and error bars.
plot_types.provenance: Synthetic; not derived from any published dataset.
plot_types.user_replacement_note: One row per replicate. 'genotype' is the x-axis, 'treatment' is the grouping color.
common_mistakes: Keep both grouping columns categorical (text).

plot_types.name: Box / violin plot with points
plot_types.description: Show full distributions per group as box or violin plots with overlaid points.
plot_types.use_case: Show full distributions per group as box or violin plots with overlaid points.
plot_types.provenance: Synthetic; not derived from any published dataset.
plot_types.user_replacement_note: One row per sample/observation. Switch box vs violin with the 'kind' option.
common_mistakes: Use enough samples per group (>=5) for a meaningful distribution.

plot_types.name: Scatter plot
plot_types.description: Relationship between two continuous variables, colored by group, optional fit line.
plot_types.use_case: Relationship between two continuous variables, colored by group, optional fit line.
plot_types.provenance: Synthetic; not derived from any published dataset.
plot_types.user_replacement_note: x and y must be numeric. Leave 'label' blank for points you don't want annotated.
common_mistakes: Blank labels are fine; non-numeric x/y will be dropped.

plot_types.name: Line / time-course with error band
plot_types.description: Mean response over time per treatment, with a shaded SEM/CI error band.
plot_types.use_case: Mean response over time per treatment, with a shaded SEM/CI error band.
plot_types.provenance: Synthetic; not derived from any published dataset.
plot_types.user_replacement_note: Long format: one row per time point per replicate. 'treatment' colors the lines.
common_mistakes: Keep time numeric and data in long (not wide) format.

plot_types.name: Clustered heatmap
plot_types.description: Gene-by-sample expression matrix with optional row/column clustering.
plot_types.use_case: Gene-by-sample expression matrix with optional row/column clustering.
plot_types.provenance: Synthetic; not derived from any published dataset.
plot_types.user_replacement_note: First column = row label (gene). All other columns are numeric samples.
common_mistakes: Keep the first column as labels; every other column must be numeric.

plot_types.name: Volcano plot
plot_types.description: Differential expression: log2 fold change vs significance, highlighting hits.
plot_types.use_case: Differential expression: log2 fold change vs significance, highlighting hits.
plot_types.provenance: Synthetic; not derived from any published dataset.
plot_types.user_replacement_note: One row per gene/feature. Provide p_value (and adjusted_p_value if available).
common_mistakes: p-values must be numeric (scientific notation is fine).

plot_types.name: Enrichment dot plot
plot_types.description: Pathway/term enrichment: dot size = gene count, color = significance.
plot_types.use_case: Pathway/term enrichment: dot size = gene count, color = significance.
plot_types.provenance: Synthetic; not derived from any published dataset.
plot_types.user_replacement_note: One row per enriched term. Provide FDR (the app derives -log10 FDR if missing).
common_mistakes: gene_ratio should be a fraction between 0 and 1.

plot_types.name: Kaplan-Meier survival curve
plot_types.description: Survival probability over time by group, with censoring marks.
plot_types.use_case: Survival probability over time by group, with censoring marks.
plot_types.provenance: Synthetic; not derived from any published dataset.
plot_types.user_replacement_note: One row per patient. event=1 means the event occurred; event=0 means censored.
common_mistakes: Encode event as 1/0, not text.

plot_types.name: Stacked composition bar plot
plot_types.description: Cell-type (or category) composition per sample as stacked fractions.
plot_types.use_case: Cell-type (or category) composition per sample as stacked fractions.
plot_types.provenance: Synthetic; not derived from any published dataset.
plot_types.user_replacement_note: Long format: one row per sample per cell type. Fractions should sum to ~1 per sample.
common_mistakes: Fractions per sample should add up to about 1.0.

plot_types.name: Waterfall plot
plot_types.description: Best percent change per patient (oncology response), sorted into a waterfall.
plot_types.use_case: Best percent change per patient (oncology response), sorted into a waterfall.
plot_types.provenance: Synthetic; not derived from any published dataset.
plot_types.user_replacement_note: One row per patient. Use negative values for tumor shrinkage.
common_mistakes: best_percent_change must be numeric (can be negative).

plot_types.name: PCA scatter (matrix + metadata)
plot_types.description: PCA of an expression matrix; samples colored by group and shaped by batch.
plot_types.use_case: PCA of an expression matrix; samples colored by group and shaped by batch.
plot_types.provenance: Synthetic; not derived from any published dataset.
plot_types.user_replacement_note: Provide the matrix (genes x samples) as data, and a metadata table whose 'sample_id' matches the matrix sample column names.
common_mistakes: Metadata sample_id values must exactly match the matrix column headers.

plot_types.name: Oncoprint mutation heatmap
plot_types.description: Gene-by-sample alteration grid (oncoprint) colored by alteration type.
plot_types.use_case: Gene-by-sample alteration grid (oncoprint) colored by alteration type.
plot_types.provenance: Synthetic; not derived from any published dataset.
plot_types.user_replacement_note: One row per alteration (a patient/gene can appear multiple times).
common_mistakes: alteration_type should use a small, consistent set of labels.

plot_types.name: Lollipop mutation plot
plot_types.description: Mutation counts along a protein, as lollipops colored by mutation type.
plot_types.use_case: Mutation counts along a protein, as lollipops colored by mutation type.
plot_types.provenance: Synthetic; not derived from any published dataset.
plot_types.user_replacement_note: One row per protein position. Positions and counts must be integers.
common_mistakes: Use integer protein positions and counts.

plot_types.name: ROC curve
plot_types.description: ROC curves with AUC comparing one or two classifier scores.
plot_types.use_case: ROC curves with AUC comparing one or two classifier scores.
plot_types.provenance: Synthetic; not derived from any published dataset.
plot_types.user_replacement_note: true_label is 1 for the positive class, 0 for negative. Scores are continuous.
common_mistakes: Include both classes (some 1s and some 0s).

plot_types.name: Forest plot
plot_types.description: Subgroup effect sizes (hazard/odds ratios) with confidence intervals.
plot_types.use_case: Subgroup effect sizes (hazard/odds ratios) with confidence intervals.
plot_types.provenance: Synthetic; not derived from any published dataset.
plot_types.user_replacement_note: One row per subgroup. Provide the estimate and its CI bounds.
common_mistakes: ci_low must be <= estimate <= ci_high.

plot_types.name: Ridge / density plot
plot_types.description: Stacked density (ridgeline) distributions of a value per condition.
plot_types.use_case: Stacked density (ridgeline) distributions of a value per condition.
plot_types.provenance: Synthetic; not derived from any published dataset.
plot_types.user_replacement_note: One row per observation. The x value (pseudotime/score) must be numeric.
common_mistakes: Provide many rows per group for smooth densities.

plot_types.name: Dot / strip plot
plot_types.description: Show every observation per group with an optional mean/median summary — a readable alternative to a bar plot.
plot_types.use_case: Show every observation per group with an optional mean/median summary — a readable alternative to a bar plot.
plot_types.provenance: Synthetic; not derived from any published dataset.
plot_types.user_replacement_note: One row per observation. 'group' is categorical (x); 'value' is numeric (y). Choose the summary overlay (mean/median with SD/SEM/CI) or turn it off.
common_mistakes: Give raw observations, not group means.
Keep 'group' as text and 'value' as numbers.

plot_types.name: Beeswarm plot
plot_types.description: Show every observation per group with a collision-avoiding layout — a readable alternative to a bar plot.
plot_types.use_case: Show every observation per group with a collision-avoiding layout — a readable alternative to a bar plot.
plot_types.provenance: Synthetic; not derived from any published dataset.
plot_types.user_replacement_note: One row per observation. 'group' is categorical (x); 'value' is numeric (y). Optionally color points by another category.
common_mistakes: Give raw observations, not group means.
Keep 'group' as text and 'value' as numbers.

plot_types.name: Paired dot plot / slopegraph
plot_types.description: Connect matched observations across conditions/timepoints (before/after, repeated measures).
plot_types.use_case: Connect matched observations across conditions/timepoints (before/after, repeated measures).
plot_types.provenance: Synthetic; not derived from any published dataset.
plot_types.user_replacement_note: Long format: one row per subject per condition. 'subject' matches paired rows; 'condition' is the timepoint (x); 'value' is numeric. Optionally color by group.
common_mistakes: Use the same 'subject' id across conditions so lines connect.
Keep data long (one row per subject per condition), not wide.

plot_types.name: Raincloud plot
plot_types.description: Full distribution per group as a half-violin cloud + box summary + raw points.
plot_types.use_case: Full distribution per group as a half-violin cloud + box summary + raw points.
plot_types.provenance: Synthetic; not derived from any published dataset.
plot_types.user_replacement_note: One row per observation. 'group' is categorical (x); 'value' is numeric (y).
common_mistakes: Provide enough observations per group (>=10) for a meaningful density.
Keep 'value' numeric.

plot_types.name: Hierarchical clustering dendrogram
plot_types.description: Hierarchical clustering of a feature-by-sample matrix as a standalone dendrogram.
plot_types.use_case: Hierarchical clustering of a feature-by-sample matrix as a standalone dendrogram.
plot_types.provenance: Synthetic; not derived from any published dataset.
plot_types.user_replacement_note: First column = row label (gene). All other columns are numeric samples. Choose linkage (average/complete/single/ward) and whether to cluster rows or columns.
common_mistakes: Keep the first column as labels; every other column must be numeric.
Ward linkage always uses a Euclidean metric.

plot_types.name: MA plot (differential expression)
plot_types.description: Differential expression: average abundance (A) vs log fold change (M), colored by significance.
plot_types.use_case: Differential expression: average abundance (A) vs log fold change (M), colored by significance.
plot_types.provenance: Synthetic; not derived from any published dataset.
plot_types.user_replacement_note: One row per gene/feature. Provide average expression (AveExpr/baseMean/logCPM), log fold change (logFC/log2FoldChange), and a p-value/FDR column (read verbatim).
common_mistakes: p-values must be numeric; they are never recomputed.
Column names are auto-detected but can be remapped.

plot_types.name: Manhattan plot (GWAS)
plot_types.description: Genome-wide association -log10(p) across chromosomes with significance thresholds.
plot_types.use_case: Genome-wide association -log10(p) across chromosomes with significance thresholds.
plot_types.provenance: Synthetic; not derived from any published dataset.
plot_types.user_replacement_note: One row per variant. Provide chromosome, genomic position (numeric), and p-value (numeric).
common_mistakes: Positions must be numeric; p-values in (0, 1].
Chromosomes may be '1'..'22','X','Y','MT' (with or without a 'chr' prefix).

plot_types.name: Q-Q plot (p-value / quantile)
plot_types.description: Observed vs expected -log10(p) Q-Q plot with genomic inflation (lambda).
plot_types.use_case: Observed vs expected -log10(p) Q-Q plot with genomic inflation (lambda).
plot_types.provenance: Synthetic; not derived from any published dataset.
plot_types.user_replacement_note: For 'pvalue' mode, provide a p-value column. For 'quantile' mode, map 'observed' to a numeric column to check normality against theoretical quantiles.
common_mistakes: p-values must be numeric and in (0, 1].

plot_types.name: Bland-Altman (method agreement)
plot_types.description: Agreement between two measurement methods (bias and limits of agreement).
plot_types.use_case: Agreement between two measurement methods (bias and limits of agreement).
plot_types.provenance: Synthetic; not derived from any published dataset.
plot_types.user_replacement_note: One row per paired measurement. Map the two method/device columns; both must be numeric.
common_mistakes: Both method columns must be numeric.
Rows are paired measurements of the SAME samples.

plot_types.name: Precision-recall curve
plot_types.description: Precision vs recall for one or two classifiers on an imbalanced outcome, with average precision (AUPRC).
plot_types.use_case: Precision vs recall for one or two classifiers on an imbalanced outcome, with average precision (AUPRC).
plot_types.provenance: Synthetic; not derived from any published dataset.
plot_types.user_replacement_note: true_label is 1 for the positive class, 0 for negative. Scores are continuous model outputs.
common_mistakes: Include both classes (some 1s and some 0s).
AUPRC is the average precision; it is computed only from valid labels+scores.

plot_types.name: Confusion matrix
plot_types.description: Classification confusion matrix (binary or multiclass) with optional row/column/total normalization.
plot_types.use_case: Classification confusion matrix (binary or multiclass) with optional row/column/total normalization.
plot_types.provenance: Synthetic; not derived from any published dataset.
plot_types.user_replacement_note: One row per prediction: the true class and the predicted class. Or provide a precomputed matrix (first column = true label, other columns = predicted classes).
common_mistakes: Use a small, consistent set of class labels.
Switch counts vs percentages with the 'normalize' option.

plot_types.name: Calibration plot
plot_types.description: Reliability of a clinical risk model: predicted vs observed probability, binned, with a perfect-calibration diagonal.
plot_types.use_case: Reliability of a clinical risk model: predicted vs observed probability, binned, with a perfect-calibration diagonal.
plot_types.provenance: Synthetic; not derived from any published dataset.
plot_types.user_replacement_note: true_label is 1/0; predicted_prob is the model's probability in [0,1]. Or provide precomputed 'predicted' and 'observed' probability columns.
common_mistakes: Predicted probabilities must be between 0 and 1.
The Brier score is reported in metadata, not drawn on the figure.

plot_types.name: Dose-response curve
plot_types.description: Drug dose-response with a 4-parameter logistic fit and EC50/IC50 per group.
plot_types.use_case: Drug dose-response with a 4-parameter logistic fit and EC50/IC50 per group.
plot_types.provenance: Synthetic; not derived from any published dataset.
plot_types.user_replacement_note: One row per well/measurement. Dose must be positive (log x-axis). Optionally group by drug/condition. A 4PL curve is fit per group when 'fit' is on; EC50 is reported only when the fit converges.
common_mistakes: Dose must be positive (non-positive doses are dropped for the log axis).
Provide several dose levels spanning the response so the fit can converge.

plot_types.name: UpSet plot (set intersections)
plot_types.description: Intersections among many sets (a scalable alternative to Venn diagrams).
plot_types.use_case: Intersections among many sets (a scalable alternative to Venn diagrams).
plot_types.provenance: Synthetic; not derived from any published dataset.
plot_types.user_replacement_note: Use one 0/1 column per set (each row = one element), or long form (element + set columns). Set mapping['sets'] to your set columns.
common_mistakes: Membership columns must be 0/1 (or boolean).
Provide at least 2 sets.

plot_types.name: Swimmer plot
plot_types.description: Per-patient treatment/follow-up timelines (oncology), colored by response with event markers.
plot_types.use_case: Per-patient treatment/follow-up timelines (oncology), colored by response with event markers.
plot_types.provenance: Synthetic; not derived from any published dataset.
plot_types.user_replacement_note: One row per patient. Provide an 'end' time (or a 'duration'); 'start' defaults to 0. Optionally add an event-type column (progression/death/response/...) and a group column.
common_mistakes: Give an end time OR a duration.
Keep event/response labels to a small consistent set.

plot_types.name: Spider plot (longitudinal change)
plot_types.description: Longitudinal per-patient change over time (e.g. % change in tumor burden), one line per patient.
plot_types.use_case: Longitudinal per-patient change over time (e.g. % change in tumor burden), one line per patient.
plot_types.provenance: Synthetic; not derived from any published dataset.
plot_types.user_replacement_note: Long format: one row per patient per timepoint. 'time' and 'value' must be numeric. Optionally color by a response/treatment group; set a reference line (default 0%).
common_mistakes: Keep the data long (one row per patient per timepoint), not wide.
time and value must be numeric.

plot_types.name: Sankey / alluvial flow (two-stage)
plot_types.description: Flow between two sets of categories (e.g. baseline state -> outcome).
plot_types.use_case: Flow between two sets of categories (e.g. baseline state -> outcome).
plot_types.provenance: Synthetic; not derived from any published dataset.
plot_types.user_replacement_note: One row per source->target flow, with a numeric 'value'. Map your source, target, and value columns.
common_mistakes: 'value' must be numeric and positive.
v0.4 supports two-stage flows (source -> target) only.

plot_types.name: UMAP / t-SNE embedding scatter
plot_types.description: Single-cell / sample embedding (UMAP or t-SNE) colored by cluster or metadata.
plot_types.use_case: Single-cell / sample embedding (UMAP or t-SNE) colored by cluster or metadata.
plot_types.provenance: Synthetic; not derived from any published dataset.
plot_types.user_replacement_note: Upload PRECOMPUTED coordinates (one row per cell/sample). Point color can be a category (cluster/cell type) or a continuous value; the app picks a legend or colorbar. Upload precomputed UMAP/t-SNE coordinates as a table; direct .h5ad/AnnData support is planned for a future version.
common_mistakes: Compute UMAP/t-SNE in your analysis tool first — this plots existing coordinates.
Coordinate columns must be numeric (e.g. UMAP_1, UMAP_2).

plot_types.name: Network graph
plot_types.description: Interaction / co-expression network: nodes are genes/features, edges are interactions or correlations, colored by module and sized by degree.
plot_types.use_case: Interaction / co-expression network: nodes are genes/features, edges are interactions or correlations, colored by module and sized by degree.
plot_types.provenance: Synthetic; not derived from any published dataset.
plot_types.user_replacement_note: Provide an edge list (source, target, optional weight). Add a node-attributes table (nodes.csv) with node, group, value to color/size nodes. Adjacency-matrix and correlation-network modes are also supported (see the folder).
common_mistakes: Keep source/target as node names (text).
A correlation network shows association, not a mechanistic interaction.

plot_types.name: Hierarchical clustering (heatmap + clusters)
plot_types.description: Cluster a feature-by-sample matrix into k groups and export the cluster assignment table.
plot_types.use_case: Cluster a feature-by-sample matrix into k groups and export the cluster assignment table.
plot_types.provenance: Synthetic; not derived from any published dataset.
plot_types.user_replacement_note: First column = row label (gene); other columns are numeric samples. Choose k, scaling, distance metric, and linkage; the cluster assignment is exported as a table.
common_mistakes: Keep the first column as labels; every other column must be numeric.
Ward linkage requires the euclidean metric.
k must be between 2 and the number of clustered objects.
